csv_project_name: Engr Svc for Martin County Airport Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Martin, North Carolina is requesting submittals from qualified firms for airport consulting/engineering services (including planning, design, and construction administration services for airside and landside improvements) at the Martin County Airport. The improvements may include, but are not limited to the following: Runways, taxiways, taxilanes, fencing, NAVAIDS, terminal buildings, utilities, aircraft aprons, aircraft hangars, pavement overlays, access roads, auto parking facilities, and land acquisition, as well as planning and other tasks and projects as deemed necessary by Martin County. This selection will be for a period of five (5) years, more or less.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Transportation Planning
title: Engineering Services for Martin County Airport Improvements

services: Airport consulting and engineering services including planning, design, and construction administration for airside and landside improvements; disciplines requested include landscape architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an airport consulting framework-like services contract, not a defined bridge, roof, stadium, or special structural project.
- Scope is broad and multidisciplinary, with strong emphasis on civil, planning, and airport infrastructure.

- Contract covers multiple possible tasks over five years rather than a clearly defined single structure.
- Several requested disciplines fall outside sbp's core focus, such as landscape architecture, geotechnics, and general airport planning.
